title: Process identity
description: The identity file every process folder carries as process.yaml. Declared paths are relative to the process folder and must stay inside it. A process declares exactly one of flow (one Flow file) or flows (Flow files by key); a run chooses its flow by key, and default_flow names the one it gets when it chooses none.

flow.description: Path of the Flow file, for a process with one flow.

flows.description: Paths of the Flow files by flow key (for example v1 and v2), for a process with more than one flow.

default_flow.description: The flows key a run gets when it chooses none; absent means v1, else the first key.

roles.description: Paths of the executing role folders.
